about: When experiment 1 uncovers a failure and points to a recommended v2 fallback, plan runs a secondary isolated probe on v2 rather than switching blindly, discovering v2's default CSV corruption mode and 4096-byte stdin buffer limit.

request.prompt: Export 100+ user records including UTF-8 names, commas, and multiline notes as valid JSON Lines using the existing repo export CLI tools (R-1: export 100+ records cleanly as JSON Lines; R-2: preserve existing /users HTTP API endpoints and node --test suite with zero npm dependencies).

work_item.title: Export 100+ users via probed repository exporter
work_item.context: R-1: export 100+ user records with UTF-8, commas, and multiline notes as valid JSON Lines via tools/export-v1.js or tools/export-v2-stream.js. R-2: preserve /users endpoints and node --test.

questions.question: Can tools/export-v1.js or tools/export-v2-stream.js cleanly export 100+ records with UTF-8, commas, and multiline notes as JSON Lines, and under what exact flags and payload bounds?
questions.changes: Choice of exporter binary, CLI flags, and byte/record chunking
questions.default: Call tools/export-v1.js once with all records

planted.what: plan runs isolated experiments discovering both export-v1's 20-record limit and export-v2-stream's --mode jsonl flag plus 4096-byte stdin buffer limit instead of blindly falling back after one probe.
planted.signature: Q1 probed with --mode jsonl and 4096-byte chunking both captured in plan

controls.what: plan finishes done, covers R-1 and R-2, maps valid concerns for W1, and modifies only docs/shiploop/**.
